description: 7-day wind forecast — internal view. Includes observation overlays and wind direction diagnostics. For wind_nbm, data is shown for the selected/repeated height_m values and observed values come from obs_wspd_kt / obs_wdir_degrees. Internal use only.

panels.description: Wind speed forecast at ${height_m} m. wind_nbm values are converted from m/s to knots and filtered to the most recent startdt at-or-before the 'From' time (within 6 h).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  windspdmean,
  windspdlb,
  windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  windspdmean AS windspdmean,
  windspdlb AS windspdlb,
  windspdub AS windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = '$group'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
      AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY "time"

panels.title: Gusts (${height_m}m)

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS "time",
    winddirmean,
    winddirlb,
    winddirub
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    forecastdtutc AS "time",
    winddirmean,
    winddirlb,
    winddirub
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
)
SELECT w."time",
       w.v1_s0 AS winddirmean, w.v1_sm1 AS winddirmean_sm1, w.v1_sp1 AS winddirmean_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_s0)) END AS winddirlb, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sm1)) END AS winddirlb_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sp1)) END AS winddirlb_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_s0)) END AS winddirub, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sm1)) END AS winddirub_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sp1)) END AS winddirub_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_s0)) END AS winddirbandlb, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sm1)) END AS winddirbandlb_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v2_sp1)) END AS winddirbandlb_sp1,
       CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_s0, w.v3_s0) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_s0)) END AS winddirbandub, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sm1, w.v3_sm1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sm1)) END AS winddirbandub_sm1, CASE WHEN LEAST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) <= 360 AND GREATEST(w.v2_sp1, w.v3_sp1) >= 0 THEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(360, w.v3_sp1)) END AS winddirbandub_sp1
FROM public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time"      ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirmean ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirlb   ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirub   ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w
ORDER BY w."time"

panels.description: Observed vs forecast wind speed at ${height_m} m. Three series: ensemble mean (windspdmean), NBM forecast (windspd column), and observed wind speed. For wind_nbm groups observed comes from wind_nbm fhr=0 rows; for legacy fog_1 groups observed is sourced from model_1 fhr=0 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fcst AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS "time",
         windspdmean,
         windspd AS windspd_nbm,
         windspdlb,
         windspdub
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
), obs_legacy AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         obs_wspd_kt   AS windspd_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND model = 'model_1'
    AND fhr = 0
    AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), nbm_run AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         windspdmean,
         windspd AS windspd_nbm,
         NULL::float AS windspd_obs,
         windspdlb,
         windspdub
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
), nbm_obs AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         NULL::float AS windspdmean,
         NULL::float AS windspd_nbm,
         obs_wspd_kt AS windspd_obs,
         NULL::float AS windspdlb,
         NULL::float AS windspdub
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND fhr = 0
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), u AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(f."time", o."time") AS "time",
         f.windspdmean,
         f.windspd_nbm,
         o.windspd_obs,
         f.windspdlb,
         f.windspdub
  FROM fcst f
  FULL OUTER JOIN obs_legacy o ON o."time" = f."time"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", windspdmean, windspd_nbm, windspd_obs, windspdlb, windspdub FROM nbm_run
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", windspdmean, windspd_nbm, windspd_obs, windspdlb, windspdub FROM nbm_obs
)
SELECT "time",
       MAX(windspdmean) AS windspdmean,
       MAX(windspd_nbm) AS windspd_nbm,
       MAX(windspd_obs) AS windspd_obs,
       MAX(windspdlb) AS windspdlb,
       MAX(windspdub) AS windspdub
FROM u
GROUP BY "time"
ORDER BY "time"

panels.description: Observed vs forecast wind direction at ${height_m} m. Three series: ensemble mean (winddirmean), NBM forecast (winddir column), and observed wind direction. Observed comes from model_1 fhr=0 rows for legacy fog_1 groups and from wind_nbm fhr=0 rows for wind_nbm groups.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fcst AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS "time",
         winddirmean,
         winddir AS winddir_nbm
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
), obs_legacy AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         obs_wdir_degrees AS winddir_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND model = 'model_1'
    AND fhr = 0
    AND obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), nbm_run AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         winddirmean,
         winddir AS winddir_nbm,
         NULL::float AS winddir_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = '$group'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
), nbm_obs AS (
  SELECT forecastdtutc AS "time",
         NULL::float AS winddirmean,
         NULL::float AS winddir_nbm,
         obs_wdir_degrees AS winddir_obs
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND fhr = 0
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND obs_wdir_degrees IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(forecastdtutc)
), u AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(f."time", o."time") AS "time",
         f.winddirmean,
         f.winddir_nbm,
         o.winddir_obs
  FROM fcst f
  FULL OUTER JOIN obs_legacy o ON o."time" = f."time"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", winddirmean, winddir_nbm, winddir_obs FROM nbm_run
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", winddirmean, winddir_nbm, winddir_obs FROM nbm_obs
), src AS (
  SELECT "time",
         MAX(winddirmean)  AS winddirmean,
         MAX(winddir_nbm)  AS winddir_nbm,
         MAX(winddir_obs)  AS winddir_obs
  FROM u
  GROUP BY "time"
)
SELECT COALESCE(mean_w."time", nbm_w."time", obs_w."time") AS "time",
       mean_w.v1_s0 AS winddirmean, mean_w.v1_sm1 AS winddirmean_sm1, mean_w.v1_sp1 AS winddirmean_sp1,
       nbm_w.v1_s0 AS winddir_nbm, nbm_w.v1_sm1 AS winddir_nbm_sm1, nbm_w.v1_sp1 AS winddir_nbm_sp1,
       obs_w.v1_s0 AS winddir_obs, obs_w.v1_sm1 AS winddir_obs_sm1, obs_w.v1_sp1 AS winddir_obs_sp1
FROM public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time"     ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirmean ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) mean_w
FULL OUTER JOIN public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time"     ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddir_nbm ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) nbm_w USING ("time")
FULL OUTER JOIN public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time"     ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddir_obs ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) obs_w USING ("time")
ORDER BY "time"

panels.description: Latest wind speed per location and available height.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  locname AS "Location",
  COALESCE(height_m, 20) AS "Height (m)",
  timestamp AS "Last Updated",
  windspdmean AS "Wind Speed"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20))
    locname,
    height_m,
    timestamp,
    windspdmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20), timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
) sub
ORDER BY locname, "Height (m)"
